description: Agent Real Estate: submit an asking price or valuation claim with the evidence in hand: the claim with its kind (an asking price, a valuation, an appraisal, a broker opinion or an automated estimate), the value and currency, the method stated (sales comparison, income, cost, automated, broker opinion or unstated), the day it was stated and its text; each comparable with its id, address, status (sold, pending, active or expired), its sale price or, for one not sold, its list price, the day it sold, its living area, its distance from the subject in miles, each adjustment recorded against it with its item and amount, and its adjusted price as recorded; optionally the policy with the share the claim may sit from the middle adjusted comparable, the days after which a sale is too old, the fewest comparables and the farthest distance; and the day the evidence is read on. The signed report gives the claim, the policy, every comparable with its net adjustment, its adjusted price recomputed, its age and whether it counts as evidence or is left out as not sold, stale or distant, the adjustments that do not add up, the middle, lowest and highest adjusted sale with the claim’s difference from the middle as a share, and the age of the newest and oldest sale, and counts them, and names an unsupported value: comparables supplied with no closed sale inside the policy’s age and distance, a claim above the middle adjusted sale past the tolerance, and an adjusted price that is not the sale price plus its recorded adjustments; then a claim below the middle past the tolerance, listings or pending or expired comparables, sales older than the policy allows, comparables farther than it allows, fewer current sales than it requires and no method stated, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No comparables, no tolerance, no age limit, no day read on, a sold comparable with no sale date, or a distance limit with a sold comparable of unstated distance leaves the value unverified. This reads a conventional property value against its comparable sales and appraises nothing itself: wever_tokenized-quote-check reads a tokenized share’s quote against NAV or the market for a hidden spread, and wever_vendor-price-consistency-check reads a service vendor’s price across its own documents. Verdict realty_valuation_unsupported, realty_valuation_partial, realty_valuation_unverified or realty_valuation_supported. POST /api/realty-valuation-check. Reads the property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, appraisal, listing, brokerage or external write. Agent Real Estate reads supplied property records after the fact and checks them against themselves and against the summary or approval given to the principal: a listing, the title and ownership record, a valuation, the seller disclosure, a lease, an offer or purchase agreement, an inspection report and a closing statement. Beside it, the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read purchases of tokenized asset shares, while a realty check reads conventional property records; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read policies and coverage, which a realty check never reads; and the payment escrow tools such as wever_agent-escrow-lite hold and release funds, while a realty check holds nothing. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-real-estate-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-real-estate/.

as_of.description: The day the records are read on, such as 2026-11-02.

currency.description: A currency code, such as USD.

value.description: The asking price or value claimed.

adjustments.description: Each adjustment recorded against the comparable.

amount.description: The adjustment, negative where it lowers the price.

distance_miles.description: Distance from the subject in miles.

price.description: The sale price, or the list price for a comparable not sold.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

max_age_days.description: Days after which a sale is too old.

tolerance_percent.description: How far the claim may sit from the middle adjusted comparable, in percent.

name: wever_realty-valuation-check
title: Realty valuation check
